current_evidence: The council's 'Before you apply for planning permission' page links 'Validation requirements for minor and major applications' to this exact Version 2.0 PDF (2026-05 upload folder) and 'Validation requirements for householder applications' to the matching Householder Version 2.0 PDF. No 2023 checklist is linked any more. The version dates could not be read from the document text because the PDFs are robots-blocked.

issues.detail: All Householder requirement rows (Tree Survey, bird/bat boxes, site levels, elevations, Heritage Statement, parking plans, photographs, street scene, etc.) and most drawing-standard tab_items come from the superseded 'Householder Local Validation Checklist 2023' (2023-07). The council now links 'Householder Local Validation Checklist Version 2.0' (2026-05). Grokbot listed the v2.0 householder PDF in docs_read but did not use it as the source. The Householder rows need re-extracting from v2.0.
issues.evidence: Council page links .../2026-05/Householder%20Local%20Validation%20Checklist%20Version%202.0.pdf (314.45KB); 'No 2023 version is linked on the page'. Workbook Householder rows cite .../2023-07/Householder%20Local%20Validation%20Checklist%202023.pdf

issues.detail: The List date 2026-05-01 comes from the upload-folder path ('url path (upload month)'), not from text in the document. The checklists are titled 'Version 2.0', but the adoption or publication date could not be confirmed from the text because the PDFs are blocked to automated fetch.
issues.evidence: reference_row Date basis: 'url path (upload month)'; council page gives no date beyond the 2026-05 file paths

issues.detail: Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment is placed under Householder, but Grokbot's own excerpt says the requirement excludes householder applications.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'A Coal Mining Risk Assessment is required for Applications (excluding householder and exemptions ...)'

issues.detail: Two rows are mislabelled. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' (under Change of use - prior approval) and 'Gypsy & Traveller information' (under Full planning) are both lifted from the list of development types that trigger the Cannock Chase SAC Habitat Regulations Assessment form. They are not separate requirements, and the 'agricultural workers dwellings' bullet is not a rural worker appraisal.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'complete the habitat regulation assessment (HRA) form ...: o any housing development ... o agricultural workers dwellings ... o Gypsy, Traveller and travelling snowpersons' accommodation'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' appears under both Householder and Full planning, but its excerpt is about an Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan, not a listed-building schedule of works. The requirement name is wrong and duplicates the tree requirement.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree/hedge Protection Plan (TPP) should be provided detailing the measures to be taken to protect all trees...'

issues.detail: Many triggers are fragments that give no condition. Examples: BNG 'of 10% biodiversity net gain.'; Design and Access Statement 'application NV6 Design and Access Statement NV7 Local Validation.'; EIA 'whether an EIA is required, this process should be applied for prior to the submission'; Lighting 'a sensitive lighting plan.'; site levels 'to proposed site levels.'; Block plan 'plan and block plan.'; Street scene 'within the street scene.'; Heritage Statement (Householder) 'Link back to a simple checklist Heritage Statement - LHV14 Validation Requirement'; Parking 'Link back to a simple checklist Vehicle Parking Plans ... LHV13'.

The Flood Risk Assessment trigger quotes only 'site area is 1 hectare or more in Flood Zone 1' and omits development in Flood Zones 2 and 3, the core FRA trigger. Not verified against v2.0 text because the PDF is blocked.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'Flood Risk Assessment required for planning applications where the site area is 1 hectare or more in Flood Zone 1.'

issues.detail: Most Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the source is titled 'Validation requirements for minor and major applications' and covers all non-householder types. Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent (beyond Heritage Statement), Advertisement consent and S73 are left as '(none)' or pre-app only, although that checklist applies to them. Examples: SuDS for all major applications and the HRA for any net new dwelling in the Cannock Chase SAC zone apply equally to outline.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'All other planning applications - This checklist tells you all the information we need from you for any other type of planning application.'

issues.detail: Many tab_items are web-page navigation text, download links or process statements rather than requirements. Examples: 'Download list Validation requirements for householder applications Download PDF (314.45KB)...', 'Download list Guidance: 45-degree code Download PDF (178.63KB)...', 'Ecology survey and report requirements Download PDF (111.79KB) Guidance:', 'Heritage statements Download PDF (112.78KB) Guidance:', 'Download flood performance pdf.', the Article 12 validation-dispute statement, and 'we can offer advice prior to your formal submission'. Pre-application advice rows (Householder, Full, S73) are encouragement, not validation requirements.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' section sourced from the 'before-you-apply' web page

issues.detail: The drawing-standard items repeat: 'Should be scaled to fit onto A4 or A3 size paper We will not accept plans which have a disclaimer stating Do Not Scale' is also split into two separate items. Tree Survey and Highways/visibility splays appear with identical excerpts under both Householder and Full planning.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current minor/major checklist (Version 2.0, 2026-05), as linked from the council's 'Before you apply' page, but both v2.0 PDFs are robots-blocked, so the requirements could not be checked against the source text. Even without the source, the Householder rows come from the superseded 2023 checklist rather than Householder v2.0, and Grokbot's own excerpts show a householder-excluded Coal Mining assessment filed under Householder, HRA trigger bullets turned into separate requirements, tree text labelled as a listed-building schedule, and many fragmentary triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
